option_relations.rationale: Arrhythmogenic syncope due to multivessel coronary artery disease is related to Catecholaminergic Polymorphic Ventricular Tachycardia, which is a specific type of arrhythmia that can cause syncope.
Acute myocardial ischemia-induced syncope can be a manifestation of cardiac conditions that may lead to cardiac arrest.
Ischemic heart disease due to obstructive coronary artery disease is a broader category that encompasses various cardiac conditions, including arrhythmias and cardiac arrest.
Coronary Artery Disease (CAD) with Giant R-wave Syndrome is not directly related to the provided leaf IDs.
